Julia — thanks, and excited to partner on this.

Quick draft plan attached (Redwood_Registration_Experiments_v1.pptx). High level:
- Landing page + registration form: minimal fields (name, company, role, email, opt-in for product updates).
- Cohorts: two audience segments we recommend (Engineer/Architect track vs Product/PM track). We'll route registrants to tailored confirmation copy based on cohort.
- CTA variants (we propose testing both on landing + email):
  1) Primary CTA: "Reserve my spot — limited seats" (emphasizes scarcity)
  2) Secondary CTA: "Save to calendar & get slides" (emphasizes content value)
- Reminder cadence: 3 touches – Day after signup (confirmation + calendar), 3 days before (content tease), 1 hour before (calendar + join link). Monica, Stephanie: proposed timing and channel split in the attached RSVP_Timing_Grid.xlsx.
- Tracking: we'll append UTM params and a single HubSpot campaign id. Draft tracking tokens in the deck; please confirm Acme's preferred campaign id so we can sync.

Two asks for Acme: 1) confirm which CTA you prefer as the default (we can flip after 48-72 hours), 2) share logo/brand kit link for co-branding.

If that sounds good I'll push the landing page copy and the first nurture email thread for review by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
